title: Revolutionizing flood resilience: Human-centred AI for adaptive and regenerative urban design
title_zh: 变革洪水韧性：面向适应性与再生性城市设计的以人为本人工智能
authors: Jakub Gorzka, Izabela Burda, Jacek Józekowski, Lucyna Nyka
abstract: Urban flooding poses escalating risks under climate change, requiring planning approaches that integrate technological precision with human and ecological values. This study introduces a Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) framework for adaptive and regenerative flood-resilient urban design. Unlike conventional AI approaches focused on optimisation, HCAI embeds ethical, participatory, and context-sensitive principles into land-use governance. The paper develops a four-pillar analytical framework – technical integration, institutional arrangements, stakeholder engagement, and land-use innovation – operationalised through a document-based comparative analysis of nine cities representing diverse flood typologies, governance regimes, and documented AI/digital flood-resilience activity. Documentary evidence suggests that AI tools such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Graph Neural Networks are reported to support flood-risk prediction and response coordination in flood-risk applications, while their planning relevance depends on inclusive decision-making and regenerative land-use strategies. Cities with stronger institutional embedding of AI-enabled or digital tools within adaptive regulatory systems and participatory platforms (e.g., Rotterdam, Copenhagen, Bangkok) show clearer planning-policy pathways, whereas those relying on fragmented or project-based deployments (e.g., Venice, Sydney) show limited continuity. Findings suggest that technical capability alone is insufficient: planning relevance depends on governance maturity, ethical safeguards, civic legitimacy, and linkage to spatial planning instruments. By coupling algorithmic intelligence with participatory and regulatory innovation, the study advances a policy-oriented framework for embedding HCAI into spatial governance and identifying conditions that may support a shift from defensive flood control toward regenerative, socially just urbanism. The framework guides AI institutionalisation within land-use systems and contributes to debates on equitable, data-driven climate adaptation.
abstract_zh: 气候变化背景下，城市洪涝风险持续加剧，亟需融合技术精度与人文生态价值的规划路径。本研究提出以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于适应性、再生性防洪韧性城市设计。与侧重优化的传统AI方法不同，HCAI将伦理、参与性和情境敏感性原则嵌入土地利用治理体系。本文构建了包含技术整合、制度安排、利益相关方参与和土地利用创新四大支柱的分析框架，通过对九个代表不同洪涝类型、治理体制及AI/数字防洪韧性实践案例的城市进行文献比较分析加以验证。文献证据表明，机器学习、深度学习、图神经网络等AI工具在洪涝风险应用中可支持风险预测与响应协调，但其规划相关性取决于包容性决策与再生性土地利用策略。在适应性监管体系与参与式平台中实现AI或数字工具制度化嵌入的城市（如鹿特丹、哥本哈根、曼谷），展现出更清晰的规划政策路径；而依赖碎片化或项目式部署的城市（如威尼斯、悉尼）则呈现有限连续性。研究结果表明，单纯技术能力不足：规划相关性取决于治理成熟度、伦理保障、公民合法性及与空间规划工具的衔接。通过将算法智能与参与式及监管创新相结合，本研究提出了将HCAI嵌入空间治理的政策导向框架，并识别出可能推动从防御性洪涝控制向再生性、社会公正城市主义转型的条件。该框架为土地利用系统中的AI制度化提供指引，并推动关于公平、数据驱动气候适应的学术讨论。

title: Pricing Reform Progress: Evidence from Sovereign Spreads and Consensus Forecasts
title_zh: 定价改革进展：来自主权利差与共识预测的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.
abstract_zh: 投资者对改革进展给予回报。计量经济学结果表明，整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度与卡塔尔外部主权信用利差的收紧相关。特别是，投资者可能将财政支出纪律视为卡塔尔整体改革和经济多元化不可或缺的一部分。更广泛的全面改革进展也增强了主权信用利差抵御外部冲击的韧性。这些发现支持将财政和货币政策改革作为更广泛改革议程的一部分，以整体方式推进，正如第三国家发展战略所规划的那样。

title: Economic Assimilation of Women and Families in the Age of Mass Migration
title_zh: 大规模移民时代女性与家庭的经济同化
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: During the Age of Mass Migration, over forty percent of immigrants were women, yet most research focuses on men. Using linked 1900 and 1910 Census records, I show that economic assimilation patterns differed for men and women, and families assimilated at different rates than individuals. Immigrant families improved their relative income scores compared with US-born families, driven by reliance on multiple earners, particularly women’s and children’s labor. At the individual level, gaps between immigrant and US-born income scores were larger for women than men, and the gap for women barely changed even after twenty years of stay.
abstract_zh: 在大规模移民时代，超过40%的移民为女性，但多数研究聚焦于男性。通过关联1900年和1910年的人口普查记录，我发现男性和女性的经济同化模式存在差异，且家庭层面的同化速度与个体层面不同。移民家庭相较于本土出生家庭，其相对收入得分有所提升，这主要得益于对多重收入来源的依赖，尤其是女性和儿童的劳动。在个体层面，移民与本土出生者收入得分的差距在女性中比男性更大，且即使居住二十年后，女性的这一差距也几乎没有变化。

title: Price-Segmented Beliefs and the U.S. Housing Boom
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper shows that expected capital gains in several MSAs were higher for relatively lower-priced, rather than higher-priced, houses during the U.S. boom of the 2000s. Because buyers of lower-priced houses tend to be more sensitive to credit conditions than buyers of higher-priced houses, this paper documents patterns that are consistent with an interaction of beliefs and credit conditions in a time period where direct evidence on house price beliefs is scarce. Documenting this interaction is important for unifying beliefs and credit conditions as joint, instead of competing, explanations for the U.S. housing boom of the 2000s.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，在2000年代美国房地产繁荣期间，多个大都市统计区（MSAs）中，相对低价房屋的预期资本收益高于高价房屋。由于低价房屋的购房者往往比高价房屋的购房者对信贷条件更为敏感，本文记录的模式与信念和信贷条件在房价信念直接证据稀缺时期的相互作用一致。记录这种相互作用对于将信念和信贷条件作为共同而非竞争性解释因素来统一说明2000年代美国房地产繁荣具有重要意义。

title: Manager Pay Inequality and Market Power
title_zh: 经理薪酬不平等与市场势力
authors: Renjie Bao, Jan De Loecker, Jan Eeckhout
abstract: Manager pay has increased considerably since 1980, and so has inequality in manager pay. Over the same period, there has been a sharp rise in market power. We start from the premise that the role of managers is to increase firm productivity. When markets are imperfectly competitive, productivity not only helps firm grow in size, productivity also affects market power. We model how imperfect competition in product markets affects manager pay, and break down the contributions of firm size and market power to compensation. We find that market power, on average, accounts for 45.2% of total manager pay. Notably, there is substantial variation across managers. Top managers are disproportionately employed by firms with market power, and they benefit from it: in 2019, 80.3% of top manager pay is attributable to market power. Our main conclusion is that rise of market power explains half of the increase in average manager pay, and nearly all of the increase in manager pay inequality.
abstract_zh: 自1980年以来，管理者薪酬大幅增长，管理者薪酬不平等程度也随之加剧。同期，市场势力急剧上升。我们基于管理者职责在于提升企业生产率这一前提展开研究。当市场处于不完全竞争状态时，生产率不仅有助于企业规模扩张，还会影响市场势力。我们构建模型分析产品市场不完全竞争对管理者薪酬的影响机制，并分解企业规模与市场势力对薪酬的贡献度。研究发现，市场势力平均占管理者总薪酬的45.2%。值得注意的是，不同管理者之间存在显著差异。高层管理者不成比例地受雇于具有市场势力的企业，并从中获益：2019年，高层管理者薪酬的80.3%可归因于市场势力。我们的主要结论是：市场势力的上升解释了平均管理者薪酬增长的一半，以及管理者薪酬不平等加剧的几乎全部原因。
